design.instruct: A nine-year-old Indian girl speaking English with a light Indian accent, bright, warm and excited, high-pitched young child's voice, natural storytelling pace.
design.note: Designing again with this text gives a SIMILAR voice, not the identical one. For the exact voice, always clone reference.wav (below).

reproduce.ref_text: And that moment, an idea came. What if someone's problem is my chance? After school, I ran to the stationery shop. Pencils were three rupees each.
